a.classification_note: Use only for cross-sections shown under type a in Table 7. Rolled I-sections deeper than 500 mm checked in the web plane are assigned type a by Note 1.

b.classification_note: Use only for cross-sections and calculation planes shown under type b in Table 7.

c.classification_note: Use only for cross-sections and calculation planes shown under type c in Table 7.

axis_note: Table 7 axes x-x and y-y identify sections normal to the calculation plane used in equation (8); for other shown sections the coefficients are independent of calculation plane.
classification_policy: Arbitrary user geometry remains fail-closed: type a/b/c is not inferred without a mapped section family or explicit normative classification. Stage N2 imported profile families use profile_family_registry_v0_28_stage_n2.json to supply the current Table 7 coefficient set and mapped x/y type so existing member-stability branches can run. The coefficient values are current-SP16 values; imported legacy family/product-standard mapping remains tagged for the deferred final original-GOST/profile audit.
